card.name: Words just before 'effects' in toxicity text
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas or spaces in animal toxicity and dose-finding passages, where the word 'effects' is likely to come next. It responds to the position just before it, not to 'effects' itself.

modes.label: Dose-level linking words
modes.description: Words like 'at' or 'in' after animal findings, followed by exposure levels or results.
modes.example: Lethality after single oral doses was seen in female rats<< at>> 903 mg/kg and male

modes.label: Lowest-observed-effect phrasing
modes.description: Words inside 'lowest observed transitory toxic effects' just before 'effects'.
modes.example: The lowest<< observed>> transitory toxic effects from human ingestion of

modes.label: Citations and dose lists
modes.description: A space or comma in a citation or list of findings or doses in toxicology text.
modes.example: reduced spermatogenesis<<,>> reduced fertility, and reduced implantation sites

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting 'effects' (and 'effect') as the next word.
card.plain: It lights up on small words in toxicity write-ups where the next word is likely to be 'effects'.
